WEB-wasmJs: collectionStream maps listener failure to FirestoreResult.Error rendered in an Error-tone AuntieBanner; addKinTaleComment Err (server permission-denied/invalid-argument/not-found) flows to vm.commentError shown in an Error banner. DESKTOP-jvm: pollingStream runCatching -> FirestoreResult.Error on throw; callable HttpsError -> WriteResult.Err -> commentError banner; NOT stubbed (unlike booking notes). ANDROID: snapshot listener err -> AuntieLog.e + explicit error state (not bare emptyList) rendered as a fail-loud banner; addComment runCatching+onFailure(AuntieLog.e), Result.failure -> commentError banner.
